doc: Exploration hotspots of L_C4P2_Karsk (Level._merge_explore_hotspots; scene.json wins on name clashes). Owner: exploration stream (documentation/C4P2_DESIGN.md §4.1/§6). Every spot keeps >= 24 px from the story hotspots and NPC anchors of §4.1, >= 14 px from the other finds, >= 20 px from the spawns, and lies in the walk area of the scene that reaches it: x 30-852 = scene A (back yard and coal stage, Alexei, Monday dawn, open until c4e_inspect_notice), x 904-1895 = scene B (showcase and platform 1, Alexei, Tuesday evening, open after c4e_inspect_notice). `info` is the art contract for env-karsk: stand = where Alexei stands (feet line y 300), focus = where the thing is painted (world px), what = what must be visible there (positions follow the scenery of §4.1 left to right; an env stream may move a spot a few px with its art and then edits only the numbers here). The chats stand on NPC anchors of the story stream (maria_coal, minder_canteen, lev_sandhouse) and need no entry here. The engine reads only `hotspots` / `spawns`.

exp_duty_board.what: Irina's duty board on the plank wall of the dispatch lean-to, between her lit window and her door: seven name strips under a heading „Lokführer“, one strip with a fresh red pencil line, a pencil on a string

exp_canteen_radio.what: the canteen's back hatch (x 250-330): a pot of kasha steaming on the sill, a small brown radio beside it, the cook's arm in a white sleeve

exp_water_crane.what: the water crane between the canteen and the coal stage, its column wrapped in straw and sacking, a fire basket with glowing coke at its foot, the swivel joint mended with wire and rags

exp_kolonne_shoes.what: at the foot of the coal-stage ramp a neat row of worn Western shoes (ladies' strap shoes, men's leather shoes split by coal dust), beside them issued felt boots stuffed with straw (3-5 px, optional detail)

exp_lena_mitten.what: hidden: a small grey child's mitten nailed to a trestle post of the coal stage at knee height (2-3 px, optional)

exp_ash_pit_dog.what: the ash pit (x 600-660) glowing faintly, a sooty dog asleep in its warmth with one ear standing up

exp_barrel_fire.what: the guard's barrel fire (env-karsk's KarskBarrel actor at x 672, the guard beside it at 690): flames and sparks; on the barrel rim two thin darned ladies' gloves laid out to dry (optional detail)

exp_banner_back.what: the back of the tarpaulin fence (x 858+): sacking patches, a tent half, a potato sack with a stamp, the red letters of the front bleeding through mirrored; low on a board a child's chalk drawing of a train

exp_tarpaulin_front.what: the front of the tarpaulin fence in the floodlight: „ВОССТАНОВИМ ВМЕСТЕ“ red on white; low left a hand-wide tear with the handle of a shovel visible behind it

exp_signal_scratch.what: hidden: the foot of the restored signal post (x 940-1010): fresh paint ends a hand's width above the ballast, below it rust with the scratched letters „А. М.“ (1-2 px marks, optional)

exp_task_wire.what: side task „Ein Paket über die Linie“: at the foot of the signal a lineman's box with a coil of galvanised signal wire (left from Alexei's January repair)

exp_model_engine.what: the polished model locomotive (x 1020-1100): red ribbons on the handrails, a wreath on the smokebox door, chalk-whitened wheel rims, a small brass plate

exp_brass_band.what: the railway workers' brass band on its plank platform (x 1100-1160): two trumpets, a horn, a drum and a tuba, children sitting on the platform's edge

exp_press_buffet.what: the press canteen's table (x 1140-1260): white tablecloth, tea glasses in holders, plates of bread with red and black caviar in neat circles; at the back a curtain, behind it the band's kasha pot

exp_turntable.what: the 30-m turntable in the yard (x 1260-1320): the pit rim and the bridge with its small operator's hut, the operator's stool empty and his cap on the controller (he plays in the band); the mini-game turns the black shunting engine into stall 7, so the bridge may stay empty

exp_task_scale.what: side task: inside the sand-drying house a platform sack scale with its weighing beam, sand sacks stacked beside it

exp_two_clocks.what: over the gate to platform 1 (x ~1580): the station clock (local time, about 19.10) and beside it a smaller clock with a plate „Korridorzeit“, two hours behind

exp_platform_families.what: families seeing off at the sleeping car: a woman holding up a permit with two stamps, a man with a parcel, children on a suitcase

exp_task_parcel.what: side task: the grandmother on platform 1 (life strip: headscarf, felt boots, a parcel tied with string held against her chest)

exp_task_conductor.what: side task: the sleeping-car conductor at his car's door (life strip: uniform coat, ticket pouch, a lantern)
